versions.changelog:
Initial release of Xiangyun Bank Card OCR Skill:

- Recognizes and extracts key details from bank card images via the Xiangyun API (typeId=17).
- Supports input as local file path, Base64 string, or downloadable URL.
- Guides users through API key/secret setup on first use, storing credentials securely in config.json.
- Outputs structured results (card number, type, name, issuing bank, bank code) in a table; results auto-saved per image.
- Exports data to Excel/CSV on explicit user request using cached results to avoid redundant API calls.
- Comprehensive error handling and user prompts for API/authentication issues.
